name: Chargeback
short_description: A FinOps practice of actually billing each team or cost center for the technology costs allocated to it through an internal budget transfer.

evidence.quote: actually bill each team for what it uses, a practice called chargeback.
you move to chargeback. Now the costs flow back to the teams that incurred them.
Some enterprises use chargeback where the department pays for licenses in related services
Finance teams end up tracking manual chargebacks because subscriptions were not tagged consistently
They implemented a chargeback model that forced teams to look at their own consumption
Showback is usually the first step. Chargeback might come later.
Now the chargeback story. Fabric chargeback reporting usually allocates cost by workspace
Chargeback answers, "Who is paying?" The spend hits a cost center, a department budget, a P&L.
Every charge back discussion becomes an argument about whether the allocation rules are fair
